changeScope: Judge model only. Prompt text, task-specific schemas, calibration rows, human labels, metrics, thresholds, routing controls, temperature, and reasoning effort remain frozen.
hypothesis: GPT-5.4 Mini at medium reasoning will exceed GPT-5.4 Nano on the frozen 48-row calibration split and meet every preregistered acceptance threshold.
researchQuestion: Can GPT-5.4 Mini reproduce the existing human assessment reliably enough to justify evaluation on a newly reserved untouched audit set?

passRule.answerable: All four core scores are at least 3 and every binary failure flag is 0.
passRule.unanswerable: correctAbstention is 1 and every binary failure flag is 0.

decisionPolicy.pass: Freeze model, prompt, schemas, and thresholds; then create and preregister a new untouched audit set before any further provider evaluation.
decisionPolicy.fail: Keep automatic judging disabled and stop model escalation for the current thesis unless a new protocol is justified before inspecting additional labels.
decisionPolicy.oldAuditPolicy: The v1.1 audit has been inspected during human adjudication and is excluded from v2 selection decisions.
decisionPolicy.lockedGenerationTestPolicy: Do not access the locked generation test during judge selection.

costGuardrail.policy: Abort before sending another uncached request when accumulated valid-response cost reaches the hard stop. Costs of rejected provider responses may be unavailable and are reported separately.

limitations: The frozen calibration reference has one human reviewer and no inter-rater reliability estimate.
The later human adjudication did not independently relabel the calibration rows.
Passing calibration establishes eligibility for a new audit, not production validity.
